description: Erection of single tower block accommodating a high density residential led development (Use Class C3) with ancillary amenity and play space, along with the provision of a flexible retail space at ground floor (Use Class E), the provision of a new publicly accessible park and alterations to the public highway.This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement.
site_name: Cuba Street Site, Land At North East Junction Of Manilla Street And Tobago Street, Tobago Street, London
